item.title: Premium Candle Product Shot

turns.text: Make a product shot of a scented candle. Make it look premium.

item.tests: Resolves a vague premium-style brief through reasonable visual choices without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: A candle is clearly recognizable and is the dominant subject.
The candle and its container have clean, well-defined edges without obvious distortions.
The composition is uncluttered, with no distracting household objects.
Controlled lighting and a coordinated background present the candle as a polished retail product.

style.prompt: Premium luxury scented candle product photography, wide editorial composition. One exquisite scented candle in a substantial smoked amber glass vessel, creamy ivory wax and a single gently burning wick, unbranded vessel with no lettering or text. Set on honed warm travertine against a softly shaded warm taupe studio backdrop. Restrained styling with a small sandalwood piece off to the side suggesting fragrance. Elegant directional softbox light, delicate golden flame, realistic glass reflections, beautiful soft shadows, rich tactile materials, sophisticated warm neutral palette. Candle is the clear hero, beautifully balanced negative space, close product detail, photorealistic high-end beauty campaign, impeccable craftsmanship, no logos, no on-screen words.
